main_text.l: Colui da, ille dat, er gibt.
Noi diamo, nos damus, wir geben.
Voi date, Vos datis, jhr gebet.
Coloro danno, illi dant, sie geben.
Io dana, ego dabam, ich gab.
Tu dana, tu dabas, du gabest.
Colui dana, ille dabat, er gab.
Noi danamo, nos dabamus, wir gaben.
Voi danate, Vos dabatis, jhr gabet.
Coloro danano, illi dabant, sie gaben.

l.i: Io diedi, & ho dato, ego dedi,
Tu desti, & hai dato, tu dedisti,
Colui diede, & ha dato, ille dedit,
Noi demmo, & habbiamo dato, nos dedimus,
Voi deste & havete dato, Vos dedistis,
Coloro diedero, & hanno dato, illi dederunt,

page.notes: The left-hand column of the plusquamperfect is a brace-set list: three Italian forms on the left are paired with three Latin forms on the right, joined by a brace. Italian forms in the scan are partly illegible (e.g. "haueua", "hauena" uncertain). Bottom-right word "Ich" is probably a catchword.
